name: infinite-carousel
title: Infinite Carousel
description: Infinitely looping horizontal carousel with GSAP Draggable + inertia, plus mobile-friendly wrap/swiper fallbacks.

changelog.summary: Added cards, draggable, showNav, and mobileBreakpoint as public props instead of hardcoding them in the wrapper
Added prefers-reduced-motion support: drag inertia, nav-button tweens, and mobile scroll-snap are shortened or disabled when the user has reduced motion enabled
